subject: English
passage: During her morning routine at the botanical garden, Milagros Huaman begins her daily inspection of the rare orchid collection. With the same careful attention that Huaman applies to all her botanical work, she ______ each delicate bloom for signs of disease or pest damage.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The singular verb "examines" agrees in number with the singular subject "she," which refers to Milagros Huaman.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because the plural verb "were examining" doesn't agree in number with the singular subject "she."
